metadata.description: The AccuSights SOC and compliance agent, packaged as skills that run inside the client's own tenancy. Local-first reduction, tokenised model calls, hash-chained evidence, human-approved action.

plugins.name: accusights-core
plugins.description: Required base layer. Sensitive-data tokenisation in front of the model, local-first deterministic reduction before any AI call, and the versioned hash-chained evidence ledger every other AccuSights skill writes to.

plugins.name: accusights-compliance
plugins.description: Continuous compliance and governance: industry-to-framework selection, control-to-signal evaluation, posture scoring, drift detection, policy lifecycle, audit readiness, and underwriter-grade risk evidence. Requires accusights-core.

plugins.name: accusights-soc
plugins.description: Security operations: reachability-filtered alert triage, indexed verdict memory, IOC correlation, compound-risk detection, approval-gated containment, and response-authority checks. Requires accusights-core.
